recommendation: Keep the commit as a core source fix. It completes the FHIR-31406 behavior in current build-scope profiling guidance while leaving broader unresolved or not-yet-applied follow-up issues, especially FHIR-51439 and FHIR-56831, for their own workflows.
issue_request: FHIR-31406 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested a boolean ElementDefinition-suppress extension for comment, requirements, alias, example, mapping, label, and code, plus snapshot-generation guidance that a marked inherited property is removed from the generated snapshot; for comment, the overriding value must match because comments can convey conformance rules.
initial_application: The explicit FHIR-31406 commit ee0b208a6cb8f8c9dbe22da772a35e6044575626 added the suppress extension row to the core ElementDefinition extension spreadsheet. Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed extension definitions from R5 core source as part of the move to the FHIR Extension Pack, where input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-elementdefinition-suppress.xml now carries the active definition; core source/oids.ini still records the extension OID.
additional_context: The FHIR Extension Pack is external to the core checkout in this run, and its ig.ini/ImplementationGuide include input/definitions/*, so the extension definition itself was not re-added to core. The active core profiling page still contradicted the seed behavior by omitting removal for label and requirements, naming code.coding rather than ElementDefinition.code, failing to reference ElementDefinition-suppress, and saying mappings could not be removed or suppressed. FHIR-31405 and FHIR-40954 are unresolved, FHIR-51439 is a later Resolved - change required clarification but not an Applied/Published issue in this default run, and FHIR-56831 is a submitted extension-pack follow-up about $all.
reconciliation: Changed source/profiling.html to list the seed-approved removable descriptive properties, link to ElementDefinition-suppress for removal, preserve the comment value-match safety convention, and remove stale statements that mappings cannot be removed or suppressed. No extension-pack files were edited because the current external StructureDefinition already matches the seed resolution.
